D: A clumsy younger brother keeps wrecking his older brother's campaign for governor of Washington.
P: Serve the snacks when the campaign hits the road.
S: Cocktail franks in puff pastry, honey mustard dip

Cocktail frankfurts wrapped in flaky puff pastry with a mustard brush and sesame seeds, baked golden and served with a honey mustard dip. Cut 2 sheets thawed puff pastry into 24 strips. Brush each strip with a little Dijon mustard and wrap around 24 cocktail frankfurts. Lay seam-side down on a lined tray, brush with 1 beaten egg and sprinkle with 1 tbsp sesame seeds. Bake at 200C for 18 minutes until puffed and golden. Stir 3 tbsp wholegrain mustard into 2 tbsp honey and 3 tbsp mayonnaise for dipping and serve warm.
Toasted baguette with vintage cheddar, apple, walnuts and honey

Crisp baguette toasts topped with sharp cheddar, thin red apple slices and toasted walnuts, finished with a drizzle of honey and cracked pepper. Slice 1 baguette into 20 thin rounds, brush with 3 tbsp olive oil and bake at 190C for 8 minutes until crisp. Toast 50g walnuts in a dry pan for 3 minutes and chop. Thinly slice 2 red apples and toss with the juice of half a lemon so they stay white. Top each toast with a slice of 200g vintage cheddar and a slice of apple. Scatter with walnuts, drizzle with 2 tbsp honey and finish with cracked pepper.
M: Hideout cabin salmon with dill butter
Salmon baked in foil with dill butter, crushed potatoes, charred beans

Salmon fillets baked in foil parcels with lemon and dill butter, served with crushed garlic potatoes and charred green beans. Mash 60g soft butter with 2 tbsp chopped dill, the zest of 1 lemon and 1 crushed garlic clove. Boil 800g baby potatoes for 15 minutes, drain, crush lightly and toss with 2 tbsp olive oil and salt. Lay 4 salmon fillets on squares of foil, top each with a slice of the butter and a lemon slice, then seal. Bake at 200C for 12 minutes. Fry 300g green beans in a hot pan with a splash of oil for 4 minutes until charred.
W: Small-town apple crumble with oat crunch
Cinnamon Granny Smith apples under a crunchy oat crumble

Cinnamon-spiced Granny Smith apples under a crunchy oat and brown sugar crumble, baked bubbling and served with thick vanilla custard. Peel and slice 6 Granny Smith apples and toss with 60g caster sugar, 1 tsp cinnamon and the juice of half a lemon. Tip into a 2L baking dish. Rub 100g cold butter into 100g plain flour, then stir in 60g rolled oats and 80g brown sugar until clumpy. Scatter over the apples. Bake at 180C for 40 minutes until golden and bubbling at the edges. Warm 600ml ready-made custard and pour over each bowl.
K: Seattle cold brew with maple cream
Overnight cold brew over ice topped with maple cream

Smooth overnight cold brew over ice, topped with a pour of maple-sweetened cream that slowly swirls down through the glass. The night before, stir 100g coarsely ground coffee into 1L cold water in a jug, cover and leave in the fridge for 12 hours. Strain through a fine sieve lined with paper towel. Whisk 150ml thickened cream with 2 tbsp maple syrup until just thickened but still pourable. Fill 4 glasses with ice, pour in the cold brew and slowly pour the maple cream over the back of a spoon so it floats.
